title: specs/<feature>/tests.yaml
description: The proof plan: one test record per scenario and per task. A script is code the spex script runs; a session is a procedure a tester agent performs and records. Written by the test analyst, never by the analyst who wrote the claim.

approvals.description: Written by the script, never by a skill: the hash of this file as it was when plan ended (`spex end plan`), or when the process changed it and `spex stamp` checked it.

covers.description: What it proves: a scenario REQ-007-001/AC-1, a whole record REQ-007-001, or a task T09.

driver.description: script: a key of config.drivers, `shell`, or absent for the default (acceptance_cmd). session: browser, api, cli.

name.description: script, file-based: the test's name in the file. It starts with the token of the first id in covers: REQ_007_001_AC_1_…, TASK_007_09_…

needs.description: Env vars (GITLAB_TOKEN) or commands (`kubectl get nodes`) the test needs. The gate checks them; a missing one is the only (a person) left.

touches.description: The real systems the test writes. Each must be in config.live.

why.description: session: why a script cannot judge this.
